sigma70_10898.reason: the two published GSE108535 tables correlate at exactly 1.0 -- one monotone transform of the other, not replicates. No denominator exists for a number on this rung.

arms_ledger.verdict_note: correct -- three declared arms remain unrun; a criterion with unrun declared arms must not read as plateaued
arms_ledger.gotcha: measure_arm mutates memory only; save() is separate. A first attempt registered both arms, exited without saving, and the verdict read unchanged -- a silent no-op.

why_not_an_arm: measure_arm(criterion, name, metric: float, evidence) requires a number. A loader fix produces no metric and has no competitor, so filing it as an arm would put a bug-fix into the ledger that ranks predictors and leave the criterion blocked on a maintenance ticket.

tests.arithmetic: 6415 committed + 6 new = 6421; the 12 deleted were never committed

honest_limits: the added tests are NOT blinded -- written after the failure was known, so they pin the current state rather than prove the guard catches an unanticipated variant

circularity UNRESOLVED: the Promoter Calculator's 346 params and PromoterAtlas's urtecho2018 head may both have been fit on GSE108535; neither was checked

AUDITED AND CLOSED same day: every loader-shaped fn in dna_decode/glm/ was enumerated -- exactly ONE loader per GEO series (expression.py owns GSE108535, genomewide.py owns GSE144621, each with its own GEO_BASE). No other duplication. Cosmetic residue: DEFAULT_CACHE is defined identically in both modules -- same value, different series, no correctness consequence; recorded not fixed, since consolidating would couple two independent substrate loaders.

duplicate_loader_audit.result: one loader per GEO series; no duplication

why_an_already_fixed_trap_recurred.mechanism: the protection was INSIDE the function that got bypassed -- MIN_JOIN_RATE guards callers of load_pairs, and writing a second reader is the one action that defeats every guard attached to the first. The knowledge was perfect and sat on a path not taken.

findability_measured.reading: the search ran in the vocabulary of the CONCEPT being built (constructed variation) rather than of the DATA being loaded (the accession)

structural_fix.rule: a GEO accession may be named in exactly ONE module; the owner is declared with the trap it encodes
structural_fix.why_it_works: a second reader must name the files to open them, so it trips a test instead of silently re-deriving a solved trap
structural_fix.non_vacuity: recreating the real duplicate two filename constants in the package FAILS the guard and names the owner; removing them returns it to green

exemptions.why_a_list_not_a_narrower_regex: a guard that fired on those would be the documented trap where guards fire on the comment explaining what they ban; a visible one-line exemption beats a silent hole

defects_in_the_guard_itself.defect: ASSERTED that a bare "GSE108535" string was caught; it was not
defects_in_the_guard_itself.cause: regex required GSE\d+_<filename>, so naming the accession once and building filenames from it evaded it
defects_in_the_guard_itself.note: a claim about the guard own coverage written without running it -- the same error being fixed

defects_in_the_guard_itself.defect: anchored as  GSE\d+ , which cannot match GSE108535_sigma70 at all

defects_in_the_guard_itself.effect: caught the bare accession and missed every real filename -- exactly backwards

why_an_already_fixed_trap_recurred.remaining_hole: a module that never writes the accession digits (imports the owner filename constant, or composes f"GSE{series}_..." from a number held elsewhere) still evades. Closing it needs import-graph/AST analysis of what reaches gzip.open. Recorded, not closed.
